# File: quality.txt
#
# The quality ladder a shop is drawn from (WLD-15, WLD-16a).
#
# Zangband's t_info.txt listed 113 building types, and roughly 73 of them were
# not distinct ideas at all -- they were rungs on a ladder.  Weapon Smiths,
# Advanced Weapon Smiths, Expert Weapon Smiths, Deep Weapon Smiths, Arcane
# Weapon Smiths, Unique Weapon Smiths: one shop and six tiers, hand-authored six
# times over.  Potion stores ran the same ladder with different adjectives, and
# so did the jeweller, the temple and the rest.
#
# WLD-16a says to generate the ladder instead of enumerating it, so the tiers
# live here once and apply to any trade.  Which tier a given town's shop gets is
# scored from the country around it (WLD-15) -- population, law and magic -- so
# an arcane weaponsmith is something you travel to find rather than something
# every town happens to have.
#
# Tier 0 is the plain trade and is deliberately not listed: a shop with no
# adjective is the common case, and the file describes what is above it.
#
# name   the adjective put in front of the trade's own name
# level  added to the level the goods are generated at, which is what
#        apply_magic() works from -- so a higher tier puts better magic on what
#        it sells.  Measured over every ordinary shop, the top rung carries about
#        three times the plusses of a plain one
# stock  extra slots on the shelves
#
# The tier *number* does one more thing that no field here controls: it is how
# many extra draws the shop makes from its own stock list, keeping the deepest.
# Raising the generation level alone does not buy deeper goods, because which
# kind a shop sells comes from store.txt and nothing in that list depends on
# level -- measured, and the arcane shop's shelves came out no deeper than the
# plain one's.  With the draws, the widest-ranging shop in the game goes from a
# mean stock level of 9 to 12.
#
# The three below are the ladder as it stands.  Adding a fourth rung is adding
# a record here; nothing in the code counts them.

name:Advanced
level:8
stock:1

name:Expert
level:18
stock:2

name:Arcane
level:30
stock:3
